name: Grist
description: An insectoid planeswalker who is both a single organism and the queen of a hive that constitutes her body mass.

description_citations.text: "Grist". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Grist connects with local swarms to assemble a new form whenever she travels to a new plane.
timeline.quote: When she travels to a new plane, she connects with the local swarms to assemble a new form.
